reading.rtitle: Travel journal -- seven days, two cities
reading.source: Leão's notes, flight Lisbon to São Paulo
paras: Monday. The flight was three hours late, so I arrived in Lisbon at midnight. I had jet lag for two days.
Tuesday. I had a booking at the hotel, but my name wasn't in the system. The hotel was full, so the manager gave me a suite. A bad start, but it worked.
Wednesday. I couldn't sleep: my neighbors had a party. I called the desk and asked: could I have a quiet room? On the eleventh floor I could sleep, finally.
Friday. Dinner at Casa Lume, in Porto. There were forty guests, and there was a band. I met Paul again — I didn't recognize him with the beard.
Saturday, my favorite day. I went on a tour of the old city, I saw the river from the castle and I bought postcards for my kids.
Sunday. Now I am on the plane home. I need to unpack, but first I want to sleep. My best memory? The dinner in Porto.

listenings.text: Hi, Marta! I am back from Lisbon, finally. What a week. The flight was fine, but my bag arrived one day late, so I bought new clothes on the first day. The hotel was small, but the room had a beautiful view of the river. On Tuesday I couldn't find the restaurant you told me about, so I asked a man on the street, and he walked me there! There were only six tables, and the fish was amazing. On Friday I went on a boat tour, and I saw the city from the water. My favorite memory? That kind man on the street. Call me when you can. I need to tell you everything.

My first trip abroad was to Buenos Aires, twenty years ago. I couldn't speak Spanish, and I couldn't speak English. At the airport I needed to find a taxi, but I couldn't read the signs. A woman saw me, and she helped me. In the hotel there was a small problem: my room was not ready, so I waited for three hours. But the city was beautiful. There were old cafes everywhere, and I ate the best steak of my life. I didn't take many photos, but I remember everything. That trip was the start. Since then I want to see the world.
